question: Which is the smallest union territory of India area-wise?

options.text: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

solution:
The correct answer is Lakshwadeep

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep is the smallest union territory of India.**
 
• It consists of **36 islands with an area of 32 sq km**.
 
• It's made up of 12 atolls, 3 reefs, and 5 submerged banks out of which **10 Islands are inhabited.**
 
• Lakshadweep was formerly known as Laccadive Islands.
 
• The name Lakshadweep in Malayalam and Sanskrit means ‘a hundred thousand islands’. 
 
• **Kavaratti **is the capital of Lakshadweep.
 
• **Minicoy** is the second-largest and southernmost island and **Andrott Island is the largest of the group.**
 
• **Minicoy is separated from the rest of the Lakshadweep by a Nine-degree channel.**
 
• **The eight-degree channel separates the Lakshadweep group from the Maldives.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Puducherry,** which is mentioned as option 1, is the third smallest union territory of India area-wise, covering around 492 square kilometers of land area.
 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Island,** which is mentioned as option 3, is the second largest union territory of India area-wise, covering around 8,249 square kilometers of land area.
 
• **Ladakh** is the largest union territory of India.
 
• **Dadra undefined Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu,** which is mentioned as option 4, is a merged union territory of India. It is the second smallest union territory of India area-wise, covering around 603 square kilometers of land area.
